name: lookbk
description: 38 free visual skills from Lookbk: a kinetic title video, an 8-bit promo video, a Swiss-grid slide deck, link-preview images, a blueprint architecture diagram, two landing pages, 24 Page Kits that build website sections and whole pages (pricing, FAQ, testimonials, footer, contact, booking, a shop, a journal, a portfolio and more) and seven animated hero sections.
